questions.markdown: A series resonance network consisting of a resistor of $30\ \Omega$, a capacitor of $2\ \mu\text{F}$ and an inductor of $20\ \text{mH}$ is connected across a sinusoidal supply voltage which has a constant output of $9$ Volts at all frequencies. Calculate the resonant frequency, the current at resonance, the voltage across the inductor and capacitor at resonance, the quality factor and the bandwidth of the circuit.

Three similar coils with a resistance of $7\ \Omega$ and an inductance of $0.03\ \text{H}$ each are connected in delta configuration to a $400\ \text{V}$, 3-phase, $50\ \text{Hz}$ supply system in RYB sequence. Using $V_{RY}$ as the reference voltage phasor, determine (a) the phase currents, (b) the line currents, and (c) the active, reactive and apparent powers.

A ring forming a magnetic circuit is made from two materials.

One part is mild steel (relative permeability = $2000$) of mean length $25\ \text{cm}$ and cross-sectional area $4\ \text{cm}^2$, and the remainder is cast iron (relative permeability = $1350$) of mean length $20\ \text{cm}$ and cross-sectional area $7.5\ \text{cm}^2$.

Determine the total reluctance of the circuit. Calculate the MMF required to create a flux density of $0.75\ \text{Tesla}$ in the steel part of the magnetic circuit.

Explain the concept of electromagnetic induction using an example of a transformer. A $10\ \text{kVA}$, $415/11000\ \text{V}$, $50\ \text{Hz}$, single-phase transformer has $60$ turns on the primary. Determine the maximum flux in the core.
Describe the major components in a digital energy meter? Mention any two advantages of digital energy meters over analog energy meters.
Explain the power connection setup required for critical loads and illustrate it with a block diagram.
Explain the function of a full wave rectifier and how it differs from a half wave rectifier in terms of output voltage.
Explain how an ELCB (Earth Leakage Circuit Breaker) functions to protect against leakage currents?
Describe the different types of power converters used in Electric Vehicles (EVs) and their functions
